sourceName: Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board (TNPCB OCMMS)
documentTitle: TNPCB Consent to Operate (CTO) Renewal Statutory Guidelines

chunks.text: Consent to Operate (CTO) under Water (P&CP) Act 1974 & Air (P&CP) Act 1981 must be renewed prior to expiration. Manufacturing units operating without valid CTO face immediate statutory notice, closure order, and penal interest.
